businessGoal: Enable users to send inquiries or support requests through a contact form.

scenarios.goal: Verify that the contact form is displayed when navigating to the contact page.
Verify that all required fields are shown on the contact form.
Verify that a validation error is shown when the message is fewer than 50 characters.
Verify that a confirmation message is displayed and the form is hidden upon successful submission of the contact form.

manual.reason: The story describes visible interactions and behaviors of the contact form.

api.reason: There is no indication that the behavior can be validated through any available API functionality.

ui.reason: The acceptance criteria detail the UI behavior of form displays and interactions.
